context.target_user: Local business marketers and solo operators
context.problem: Transforming verified canonical guides into multi-channel marketing assets (Google Business Profile, FAQ schema, newsletters) efficiently.
context.use_case: Syntactic format conversion of approved articles into structured JSON-LD and short social updates.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 07, GPT-4o accurately transformed canonical clinical text into a 112-word GBP post, valid JSON-LD FAQ schema, and a patient email newsletter with 100% factual fidelity. Conditioned on technical schema syntax validation and human check against promotional tone drift.
when_to_consider: When rapidly reformatting canonical articles into diverse channel-specific formats.
When generating structured JSON-LD FAQPage schemas from existing text.
when_not_to_use: When drafting primary factual claims without grounded source material.
